W_NOT_IN_PACK: 444, 446 and 448 are DB quests outside this pack (QL16-17). They are the prerequisite chain of the elite 442 (Assault on Fenris Isle), which may not be dropped. They are routed for every race.

W_XP_RANGE: quest XP is 80% of the budget (109,005 of 136,800). Structural: the 20-25 pool outside dungeons, raids, battlegrounds, class-only chains and Teldrassil festivals is about 110k of quest XP. The Jorn chain (about 9k) is dropped because it cannot be routed for every path (905 is race-gated in horde_horde_10-15). Kills supply the rest.
